Select a contextual French skylight term; fenêtre de toit may narrow the type of opening compared with source tragaluz/skylight.
The source asks what material the roof has; decide whether the archived question about what covers the roof preserves the intended material distinction and card/Reader alignment.
Decide whether this metal-panel roof phrase denotes the roof material or a count of panels before selecting a scored French form.
